ValidationRule.description: Prevent changes on Individual for Customer Services, execpts for Finland if they try to modify certain fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISCHANGED( ER_VIP__pc ) ) && AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), $Profile.Name = 'Customer Service', IsPersonAccount, IF( AND( $User.ER_BUText__c = 'FI', OR( ISCHANGED(PersonEmail), ISCHANGED(PersonMailingAddress), ISCHANGED(PersonMailingPostalCode), ISCHANGED(PersonMailingCountry), ISCHANGED(Phone)) ), false, true ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not able to modify
